999008199.text: ララ様、よくお似合いです

localizations.en: It suits you perfectly, Queen Lara.

999008199.text:
ララ様のビッグな美しさにキングダムの民も他の人も
ひれ伏すよ！

localizations.en: Everyone in the kingdom and beyond will bow before your majestic beauty!

999008199.text: ありがとう。気に入りましたわ

localizations.en: Thank you. I'm quite pleased with it.

999008199.text:
二人とも変わらぬ素晴らしい腕前です。アンペルの
衣装も素晴らしい出来栄えですわ

localizations.en: You both remain as skilled as ever. Empel's outfit turned out wonderfully as well.

999008199.text: ああ。着心地もいいし動きやすい。私も気に入ったな

localizations.en: Indeed. It's comfortable and easy to move in. I'm quite satisfied.

999008199.text:
旅の道中、ララ様の紹介をする時もあるだろうから、
ディオたんと二人で、紹介の仕方を考えたよ

localizations.en: Since we might need to introduce our queen during our travels, Dio and I came up with an announcement!

999008199.text: ひかえい、ひかえい、ひかえおろーう！

localizations.en: Make way! Make way, one and all!

999008199.text:
こちらにおわすお方をどなたと心得る！
ララ・キングダム国王、ララ・トロッケル様で……

localizations.en: Behold, the sovereign before you! Presenting Queen Lara Trockel, ruler of the Kingdom of Lara...

999008199.text: 二人とも、そこまで派手にやらなくても結構ですわ

localizations.en: You two really don't need to be quite so... theatrical.

999008199.text:
ララさーん！　アンペルさーん！
お待たせしました！

localizations.en: Lara! Empel! Sorry to keep you waiting!

999008199.text: おや。随分と雰囲気が変わりましたね

localizations.en: My, what a striking change in appearance.

999008199.text: ええ。より王にふさわしい装いに改めたのですわ

localizations.en: Indeed. I've adopted attire more befitting a queen.

999008199.text: とってもお似合いですよ！
衣装にふさわしく、戦い方もより優美に！

localizations.en: And to match the outfit, my fighting style shall be more elegant as well!

999008199.text: ララ様、軽やか！　風のごとく！！

localizations.en: You're so graceful! Like the wind itself!!

999008199.text: 舞うような身のこなし、さすがララ様です
ふふ。王ならこの位動けませんとね

localizations.en: Hehe. A queen must at least be capable of this much.

999008199.text: さて、全員揃いましたし、早速採取に向かいましょうか

localizations.en: Now then, since everyone's here, shall we head out to gather materials?
